claim_text: Frozen PARC K=300/500 queues have lower current-MP t1 FTR than raw top-K.
Stable-to-unstable drift is not concentrated in the PARC release relative to raw top-K.
The current-MP t1 audit is not a strict alpha=0.10 temporal certificate.
Candidate-level t1 false releases are decomposed into boundary, drift, chemistry, and model-disagreement classes.
Chemical-system block bootstrap intervals quantify t1 utility and drift uncertainty.
Rank-bin randomization tests compare PARC to raw top-K, matched raw top-R, and stratified raw subsets.
Phase53 CHGNet/MACE score-support proxies favor PARC release over raw-only extra-tail at K=300/500.
Phase53 t1 false-case explanation is only partial under CHGNet/MACE score proxies.
